d.ko: Thrown into prison for an act of self-expression, protagonist Shuichiro must confront both a violent system and his own actions—or else try to find happiness on the inside in this visual novel from the makers of NUKITASHI.
d.en: Thrown into prison for an act of self-expression, protagonist Shuichiro must confront both a violent system and his own actions—or else try to find happiness on the inside in this visual novel from the makers of NUKITASHI.
d.zh: 主角柊一郎因为表达自我而被逮捕入狱，在由暴力主宰的制度下，他会选择抵抗还是服从？或者，尝试寻找内心的安宁与幸福。答案将在这部NUKITASHI制作团队出品的视觉小说中揭晓。

rv.t: The unquestionable number one among visual novels in recent years. It truly tells a story about love and self with a plot that is both deeply touching and powerful.
